documents.content: HTTP 200 on an order read means the request succeeded, not that the order completed. Callback is emitted only after COMPLETED. A PROCESSING order does not prove a callback failure. Query current order state before drawing a root cause.
documents.query: async order API 200 vs 202 contract callback notification
documents.title: Order lifecycle and callback trigger

result.reason: Need the versioned contract semantics for HTTP 200 vs 202 on this async order route before judging whether a callback is due.
Order GET shows 200 with status COMPLETED, but I still need the method to decide whether the callback is actually due before checking delivery.

skill.content: Investigate the bound order lifecycle. HTTP 200 confirms a successful read only. If PROCESSING, explain callback is not due yet; do not label transport broken. If COMPLETED, investigate the correlated callback event next. Current MCP facts override all historical hints.

model_traces.assistant_text: 已确认订单生命周期为 `COMPLETED`（order_version 2），因此回调应当已到期。下一步需要核实绑定的回调事件本身：事件版本、实际传输确认或失败，而非仅凭订单 GET 200 推断。

args.reason: 订单已 COMPLETED，需核实对应回调事件版本与传输是否实际确认成功
Order is COMPLETED and delivery is ACKNOWLEDGED (HTTP 202); need receiver-side processing state, since ACK does not prove completion.

model_traces.assistant_text: 当前订单 `async-order` 版本2为 `COMPLETED`；订单接口 HTTP 200 只代表读取成功，不代表下游处理完成。关联投递事件 `event-0fac2304...` 已 `ACKNOWLEDGED`，接收方 HTTP 202 仅表示接收方已接受，不等于接收方完成处理。同一事件在接收方仍为 `QUEUED`，因此 Gate 结论是 `RECEIVER_PROCESSING_UNCONFIRMED`，不能认定下游没有收到异步通知。当前事实纠正了“没有异步通知”的原始说法：通知已获接收确认，但处理完成尚未证实；也不能声称恢复或重发。过期的历史建议不改变当前事实，Knowledge/Memory/Skill 仅作方法参考。
